what: Plan parses REBASE_ERROR from stderr, but rebase-push.sh emits REBASE_ERROR through emit_kv on stdout/FD3
scenario_or_breakage: Non-conflict rebase failures will surface as REBASE_ERROR=unknown in the new wrapper, and the planned stderr-based harness will not catch the real integration contract
suggested_fix: Parse REBASE_ERROR from captured stdout first, use stderr only as fallback, and update the rc=3 test stub to emit REBASE_ERROR on stdout like rebase-push.sh

what: Plan captures append-execution-issue.sh failure detail from stderr, but the helper emits ERROR via emit_kv on stdout/FD3

suggested_fix: Update lib-phantom-probe.sh to capture stdout plus stderr, parse ERROR= from stdout, and only fall back to stderr text when no ERROR key is present
